changelog:
- Initial release of the SEO Audit skill providing a full website SEO audit.
- Crawls up to 500 pages, detects business type, and delegates to up to 15 SEO specialists (8 always, 7 conditional).
- Aggregates findings into an SEO Health Score (0-100) with a prioritized action plan.
- Generates detailed, structured audit reports and offers enterprise-ready PDF output.
- Integrates with optional Google API and DataForSEO for enhanced real-world data when available.
- Robust error handling for unreachable URLs, robots.txt blocks, rate limits, and large sites.
summary: Full website SEO audit with parallel subagent delegation. Crawls up to 500 pages, detects business type, delegates to up to 15 specialists (8 always + 7 conditional), generates health score. Use when user says audit, full SEO check, analyze my site, or website health check.
